detail.title: Intex 8 Kg Semi-Automatic Washing Machine (SA80BGFG / SA80MWFG)
detail.overview: Upgrade your laundry routine with the all-new Intex 8 Kg Semi-Automatic Washing Machine , designed for powerful cleaning and maximum efficiency. With its advanced Scrubber Technology and 6 Wings Pulsator , it ensures deep cleaning while being gentle on clothes. Built for Indian households, this washing machine features Salt Water Technology , making it highly durable even in hard water conditions. The Hydraulic Wash Lid and Toughened Glass Tops add convenience and durability, while the Noise-Free Spinning ensures a smooth experience. Its 8 kg capacity makes it ideal for medium to large families, and the Powerful Motor delivers strong performance for heavy loads. Equipped with smart features like a Magic Filter , Detergent Box , and End Cycle Buzzer , this machine is designed to make your laundry hassle-free.
features: 8 Kg Large Capacity – Ideal for medium to large families
Semi-Automatic Dual Tub Design for efficient washing & drying
Powerful Motor for strong and effective cleaning
Scrubber Technology for deep dirt removal
6 Wings Pulsator ensures better wash performance
Hydraulic Wash Lid for smooth and easy operation
Toughened Glass Lids for durability and premium look
Noise-Free Spinning for a quiet laundry experience
Magic Filter for effective lint collection
Salt Water Technology for enhanced durability in hard water
End Cycle Buzzer for added convenience
Water Selector Knob for easy control
2 Wash Programs for flexible washing options
5 Years Warranty for peace of mind
